name: pullover-dumbbell-straight-arm
title: Pullover: Dumbbell (Straight Arm)
primer: This is an exercise for chest and shoulder strengthening which also works the lats.
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and your head at the end of the bench.
Grasp a dumbbell and raise it over your chest.
Keeping your elbows as straight as possible, lower the weight in an arc over your head and as low to the ground as possible without any pain.
